title: Why it sucks being a midfielder

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a midfielder.
It starts when you're seven. The coach says: "You're box to box." You don't know what that means. So you just run. Everywhere.
Age ten. You run twelve kilometres. The striker runs two. He still gets the first drink at half-time.
Age twelve. You win the ball. You look up. Nobody is moving. So you pass it sideways. Coach: "Be more creative!"
Age fourteen. Every game, you get kicked. Again. And again. The referee: "Play on."
Age sixteen. Thirty yards out. You shoot... top corner! Now every time you touch the ball, the whole team screams: "PASS IT!"
Age seventeen. Fifteen assists this season. The highlight video? Fifteen goals... by the striker.
That's the thing about being a midfielder. Everyone wants the ball.
Tag the midfielder who ran for you.
